name: Juniper
tagline: A neighborhood kitchen cooking with the season.
large_party_note: Parties of seven or more, and private dinners in the back room, are booked by email.
walk_in_note: Our bar and window counter are kept for walk-ins every night.

art_direction.identity: A calm, printed-menu restaurant site: warm linen canvas, green-black ink, generous whitespace, soft natural-light food photography with rounded corners, and pill-shaped buttons.
art_direction.type: Instrument Serif for every heading and dish name (regular, with italic for course titles and descriptions); Figtree for body and interface text at 1rem with a relaxed line height; prices use tabular numerals.
art_direction.color: Linen canvas and paper surface, ink text in two tiers (ink, muted), hairline lines. One accent: primary (juniper green) only for the Reserve button, the menu card's sprig ornament, and link hovers. The Visit band is the only dark (ink) surface. Never add a second accent.
art_direction.signature: The printed menu card — a paper card with an inset hairline frame, italic course titles between rules, and dish names joined to prices by dotted leaders. Keep it wherever the menu appears.
art_direction.voice: Warm, unhurried, and specific about ingredients and farms. Short sentences. No exclamation points, no superlatives.
